title.zh: 卷三十七 本紀第三十七 寧宗一
title.raw: 卷三十七 本紀第三十七 寧宗一 Volume 37 Annals 37: Ningzong 1

sentences.zh: 寧宗法天備道純德茂功仁文哲武聖睿恭孝皇帝，諱擴，光宗第二子也，母曰慈懿皇后李氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Ningzong Fatian Beidao Chunde Maogong Renwen Zhewu Shengrui Gongxiao, taboo name Kuo, was the second son of Emperor Guangzong; his mother was Empress Ciyi, née Li.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong (personal name Kuo), posthumously titled Fatian Beidao Chunde Maogong Renwen Zhewu Shengrui Gongxiao, was Guangzong's second son; his mother was Empress Ciyi of the Li clan.

sentences.zh: 光宗爲恭王，慈懿夢日墜于庭，以手承之，已而有娠。

translations.literal: When Guangzong was Prince of Gong, Ciyi dreamed that the sun fell into the courtyard; she caught it in her hands, and thereafter became pregnant.
translations.idiomatic: While Guangzong was still Prince of Gong, Lady Ciyi dreamed the sun fell into the courtyard and that she caught it in her hands; she soon conceived.

sentences.zh: 乾道四年十月丙午，生于王邸，五年五月，賜今名。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the tenth month of the fourth year of Qiandao, he was born at the princely residence; in the fifth month of the fifth year he was granted his present name.
translations.idiomatic: He was born at the princely residence on the bingwu day of the tenth month of the fourth year of Qiandao (1168); in the fifth month of the following year he received his current personal name.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，授右千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the eleventh month, he was appointed General of the Right Qianniu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the eleventh month he was made general of the Right Qianniu Guard.

sentences.zh: 七年，光宗爲皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Guangzong became crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Guangzong was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年十月戊午，遷明州觀察使，封英國公。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the tenth month of the fifth year of Chunxi, he was transferred to be surveillance commissioner of Mingzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the tenth month of the fifth year of Chunxi (1178) he was transferred to surveillance commissioner of Ming Prefecture and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，初就傅。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, he first received tutoring.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year he began formal instruction under a tutor.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，始冠。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, he underwent the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year he underwent the coming-of-age capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 十年九月己巳，始預朝參。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the ninth month of the tenth year, he first attended court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the ninth month of the tenth year he first took part in court audiences.

sentences.zh: 十一年，當出閣，兩宮愛之，不欲令居外，乃建第東宮之側，以十月甲戌遷焉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when he was due to leave the palace quarters, both palaces doted on him and did not wish him to live outside; a residence was therefore built beside the Eastern Palace, and on the jiaxu day of the tenth month he moved there.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when he was due to leave the inner palace, both empresses favored him and did not want him living away from court; a residence was built beside the Eastern Palace, and on the jiaxu day of the tenth month he moved in.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月乙酉，遷安慶軍節度使，封平陽郡王。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the third month of the twelfth year, he was transferred to be military commissioner of the Anqing Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the third month of the twelfth year he was made military commissioner of the Anqing Army and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，納夫人韓氏。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the eighth month, he took Lady Han as his consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the eighth month he married Lady Han of the Han clan.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月壬戌，光宗受禪。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the second month of the sixteenth year, Guangzong received the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the second month of the sixteenth year Guangzong accepted the throne by abdication.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，拜少保、武寧軍節度使，進封嘉王。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the third month, he was appointed Junior Guardian and military commissioner of the Wuning Army, and advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the third month he was appointed junior guardian and military commissioner of the Wuning Army and promoted to Prince of Jia.

sentences.zh: 帝自弱齡，尊師重傅，至是，始置翊善，以沈清臣爲之。

translations.literal: The Emperor from his youth honored teachers and esteemed tutors; at this time an aide-de-camp tutor was first established, with Shen Qingchen appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood the prince had honored his teachers; only now was an aide tutor formally appointed, with Shen Qingchen named to the role.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年春，宰相留正請立帝爲儲嗣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Shaoxi, Chancellor Liu Zheng requested that the Emperor be established as heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Shaoxi (1190), Chancellor Liu Zheng petitioned to name him crown prince.

sentences.zh: 五年六月戊戌，孝宗崩，光宗以疾不能出。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year, Xiaozong died; Guangzong, owing to illness, could not go out.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Shaoxi (1194), Xiaozong died, and Guangzong, ill, could not leave the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宰臣請太皇太后垂簾聽政，不許；

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the chief ministers requested that the Grand Empress Dowager draw the curtain and hear government; this was not granted;
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the chief ministers asked the Grand Empress Dowager to rule from behind the curtain; she refused;

sentences.zh: 請代行祭奠之禮，從之。

translations.literal: they requested to perform the sacrificial rites in his stead, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: they then asked to conduct the mourning sacrifices on his behalf, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宰臣奏云：「皇子嘉王，仁孝夙成。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the chief ministers memorialized: "The Prince of Jia, Kuo, has from youth been accomplished in benevolence and filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the chief ministers memorialized: "Prince Jia has shown benevolence and filial devotion from his youth.

sentences.zh: 宜正儲位，以安人心。

translations.literal: He should be established in the heir's position to settle the people's hearts."
translations.idiomatic: He should be named heir to reassure the realm."

sentences.zh: 」越六日，奏三上，從之。

translations.literal: Six days later, after memorializing three times, [the court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: Six days later, after three such memorials, the court assented.

sentences.zh: 明日，遂擬旨以進。

translations.literal: The next day, an edict was drafted and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The next day a draft edict was prepared and submitted.

sentences.zh: 是夕，御批付丞相云：「歷事歲久，念欲退閑。」

translations.literal: That evening, an imperial rescript was delivered to the chancellor stating: "Having served many years, I wish to retire and rest."
translations.idiomatic: That evening Guangzong sent the chancellor an imperial rescript: "I have reigned long enough and wish to retire."

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，留正以疾辭去。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the seventh month, Liu Zheng resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the seventh month Liu Zheng resigned, citing illness.

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事趙汝愚見正去，乃遣韓侂胄因內侍張宗尹以禪位嘉王之意請于太皇太后，不獲。

translations.literal: Zhao Ruyu, who knew the Bureau of Military Affairs, seeing Liu Zheng depart, then sent Han Tuozhou through the eunuch Zhang Zongyin to request of the Grand Empress Dowager the idea of abdicating the throne to the Prince of Jia, but did not obtain approval.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, saw Liu Zheng leave and sent Han Tuozhou, through the eunuch Zhang Zongyin, to ask the Grand Empress Dowager to abdicate in favor of Prince Jia; she refused.

sentences.zh: 遇提舉重華宮關禮，侂胄因其問，告之。

translations.literal: He encountered Guan Li, who supervised Chonghua Palace; Tuozhou, because Li asked, told him.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou then met Guan Li, supervisor of Chonghua Palace, and when Li inquired, told him the plan.

sentences.zh: 禮繼入內，泣請于太皇太后，太皇太后乃悟，令諭侂胄曰：「好爲之！

translations.literal: Li then entered within, weeping as he pleaded with the Grand Empress Dowager; the Grand Empress Dowager thereupon understood, and ordered that Tuozhou be told: "Do it well!
translations.idiomatic: Guan Li went in at once, weeping as he pleaded with the Grand Empress Dowager; she finally understood and told Tuozhou through a messenger: "See it through properly!

sentences.zh: 」侂胄出，告汝愚，命殿帥郭杲夜分兵衛南北內［一］。

translations.literal: Tuozhou came out, informed Ruyu, and ordered the palace commander Guo Gao at midnight to deploy troops to guard the northern and southern inner palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou came out, informed Zhao Ruyu, and ordered palace commander Guo Gao to post troops through the night guarding the northern and southern inner palaces.

sentences.zh: 翌日禫祭，汝愚率百官詣大行柩前，太皇太后垂簾，汝愚率同列再拜，奏：「皇帝疾，不能執喪，臣等乞立皇子嘉王爲太子，以安人心。

translations.literal: The next day at the end-of-mourning sacrifice, Ruyu led the hundred officials to the late emperor's bier; the Grand Empress Dowager drew the curtain. Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing twice and memorialized: "The Emperor is ill and cannot perform the mourning; we beg to establish the Prince of Jia, Kuo, as crown prince to settle the people's hearts."
translations.idiomatic: The next day, at the end-of-mourning rites, Zhao Ruyu led the officials before Xiaozong's bier while the Grand Empress Dowager sat behind the curtain. Ruyu bowed with his colleagues and said: "The emperor is too ill to preside over mourning; we ask that Prince Jia be made crown prince to steady the realm."

sentences.zh: 」乃奉御批八字以奏。

translations.literal: He then presented the eight characters of the imperial rescript in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He then presented Guangzong's eight-character rescript as evidence.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后曰：「既有御筆，卿當奉行。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager said: "Since there is an imperial hand, you should carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager said: "Since there is an imperial hand, you should execute it.

sentences.zh: 」汝愚曰：「內禪事重，須議一指揮。

translations.literal: Ruyu said: "An inner abdication is weighty; a directive must be deliberated."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu replied: "An abdication within the palace is a grave matter; we need a formal order."

sentences.zh: 」太皇太后允諾。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager agreed.

sentences.zh: 汝愚袖出所擬以進，云：「皇帝以疾，未能執喪，曾有御筆，欲自退閑，皇子嘉王擴可即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Ruyu drew from his sleeve the draft he had prepared and submitted it, saying: "The Emperor, owing to illness, is unable to perform mourning; he once wrote in his own hand that he wishes to retire. The Prince of Jia, Kuo, may immediately take the imperial position."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu produced from his sleeve the draft he had prepared: "The emperor, ill, cannot conduct mourning and has written that he wishes to retire. Prince Jia Kuo may immediately ascend the throne."

sentences.zh: 尊皇帝爲太上皇，皇后爲太上皇后。

translations.literal: Honor the Emperor as Retired Emperor and the Empress as Retired Empress."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor shall be honored as Retired Emperor and the empress as Retired Empress."

sentences.zh: 」太皇太后覽畢，曰：「甚善。」

translations.literal: When the Grand Empress Dowager had finished reading, she said: "Very good."
translations.idiomatic: After reading it through, the Grand Empress Dowager said: "Excellent."

sentences.zh: 汝愚出，以旨諭帝，帝固辭曰：「恐負不孝名。

translations.literal: Ruyu went out and conveyed the directive to the Emperor; the Emperor firmly declined, saying: "I fear bearing the name of unfilial conduct."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu went out and told the prince; Kuo firmly refused, saying: "I fear the charge of unfilial conduct."

sentences.zh: 」汝愚曰：「天子當以安社稷、定國家爲孝，今中外憂亂，萬一變生，置太上皇何地！

translations.literal: Ruyu said: "The Son of Heaven should take securing the altars of soil and grain and stabilizing the state as filial piety. Now within and without there is alarm and disorder; if by any chance trouble arises, where will the Retired Emperor be placed!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu said: "A ruler's filial duty is to secure the realm. The court and country are in turmoil; if anything goes wrong, what becomes of the retired emperor?"

sentences.zh: 」衆扶入素幄，披黃袍，方卻立未坐，汝愚率同列再拜。

translations.literal: The crowd helped him into the white canopy, draped the yellow robe on him; he had just stepped back and not yet sat down when Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing twice.
translations.idiomatic: The officials helped him into the white mourning canopy and draped the yellow robe on him; he had stepped back and not yet sat when Zhao Ruyu led his colleagues in bowing.

sentences.zh: 帝詣几筵殿。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Hall of the Spirit Tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The new emperor went to the Hall of the Spirit Tablet.

sentences.zh: 哭盡哀。

translations.literal: He wept to the full measure of grief.
translations.idiomatic: He wept his fill.

sentences.zh: 須臾立仗訖，催百官班，帝衰服出，就重華殿東廡素幄立，內侍扶掖，乃坐。

translations.literal: Shortly the guard formation was complete; the hundred officials' ranks were urged forward. The Emperor came out in mourning dress, took his place standing in the white canopy in the eastern corridor of Chonghua Hall; eunuchs supported him, and then he sat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the guard was drawn up and the officials hurried into formation. The emperor came out in mourning garb, stood in the white canopy in the eastern corridor of Chonghua Hall, was steadied by attendants, and then sat.

sentences.zh: 百官起居訖，乃入行禫祭禮。

translations.literal: When the hundred officials had finished their greetings, he then proceeded to perform the end-of-mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: After the officials had paid their respects, he conducted the end-of-mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 詔建泰安宮，以奉太上皇、太上皇后。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the building of Tai'an Palace to serve the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Tai'an Palace built to house the retired emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 汝愚即喪次請召還留正。

translations.literal: Ruyu, at the mourning site, immediately requested that Liu Zheng be recalled.
translations.idiomatic: At the mourning site Zhao Ruyu at once asked that Liu Zheng be recalled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太皇太后命立崇國夫人韓氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the Grand Empress Dowager ordered that Lady Han of Chongguo be established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day the Grand Empress Dowager named Lady Han of Chongguo empress.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 百官進秩一級， 賞諸軍。

translations.literal: The hundred officials were advanced one rank in grade; the armies were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: All officials were promoted one grade and the armies were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 詔車駕五日一朝泰安宫，百官月两朝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the imperial carriage attend Tai'an Palace every five days and that the hundred officials attend twice monthly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required the emperor to visit Tai'an Palace every five days and officials to attend twice a month.

sentences.zh: 以即位告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: The accession was announced to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The accession was announced at the rites to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，侍御史張叔椿劾留正擅去相位，詔以叔椿爲吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Remonstrance Censor Zhang Shuchun impeached Liu Zheng for leaving the chancellorship on his own authority; an edict appointed Shuchun Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Censor Zhang Shuchun impeached Liu Zheng for abandoning office without leave; the court made Zhang vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict called for frank memorials.

sentences.zh: 遣鄭湜使金告禪位。

translations.literal: Zheng Shi was dispatched as envoy to Jin to announce the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Shi was sent to Jin to announce the abdication.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以趙汝愚兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Zhao Ruyu was appointed concurrently as Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Zhao Ruyu was named concurrent vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，召秘閣修撰、知潭州朱熹詣行在。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Zhu Xi, Compiler at the Hanlin Academy and prefect of Tanzhou, was summoned to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Zhu Xi, Hanlin compiler and prefect of Tanzhou, was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬申，建泰安宮。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Tai'an Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day construction of Tai'an Palace began.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以趙汝愚爲右丞相，參知政事陳騤知樞密院事，餘端禮參知政事，仍兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Zhao Ruyu was made Right Chancellor; Vice Grand Councilor Chen Gui was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Duanli was made Vice Grand Councilor and still concurrently Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Zhao Ruyu became right chancellor; Chen Gui became military affairs commissioner; Yu Duanli became vice grand councilor while retaining his post as associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 汝愚辭不拜。

translations.literal: Ruyu declined and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 賜前宰執、侍從詔，訪以得失。

translations.literal: Edicts were bestowed on former chancellors and attendants, inquiring into gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Former chancellors and palace attendants were given edicts asking their views on what had gone right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day a violent wind arose.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔：秋暑，太上皇帝未須移御，即以寢殿爲泰安宮。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, an edict stated: "In the autumn heat, the Retired Emperor need not yet move his residence; let his sleeping hall serve as Tai'an Palace."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day an edict said that in the autumn heat the retired emperor need not move yet and that his sleeping hall would serve as Tai'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 以殿前都指揮使郭杲爲武康軍節度使，庚辰，率群臣拜表于泰安宮。

translations.literal: Palace Commander Guo Gao was made military commissioner of the Wukang Army; on the gengchen day, [the emperor] led the hundred officials in presenting a memorial at Tai'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Palace commander Guo Gao was made military commissioner of the Wukang Army; on the gengchen day the emperor led the officials in presenting a memorial at Tai'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以趙汝愚爲樞密使，保大軍節度使郭師禹爲攢宮總護使。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Zhao Ruyu was made Commissioner of Military Affairs; Guo Shiyu, military commissioner of the Baoda Army, was made overall supervisor of the spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Zhao Ruyu became military affairs commissioner and Guo Shiyu, military commissioner of the Baoda Army, was named overall supervisor of the imperial tomb works.

sentences.zh: 壬午，侍御史章穎等劾內侍林億年、陳源、楊舜卿，詔億年、源與在外宮觀，舜卿在京宮觀。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Attending Censor Zhang Ying and others impeached the eunuchs Lin Yinian, Chen Yuan, and Yang Shunqing; an edict assigned Yinian and Yuan to outer palace chapels and Shunqing to a capital chapel.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Censor Zhang Ying and others impeached the eunuchs Lin Yinian, Chen Yuan, and Yang Shunqing; Lin and Chen were sent to provincial palace chapels and Yang to one in the capital.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄落階官，爲汝州防禦使。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou was stripped of his graded offices and made defense commissioner of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou was stripped of his court ranks and made defense commissioner of Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，餘端禮辭兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Yu Duanli resigned his concurrent post as Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Yu Duanli resigned as associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以兵部尚書羅點簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Luo Dian, Minister of War, was appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Minister of War Luo Dian was appointed to sign at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔兩省官詳定應詔封事，具要切者以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered officials of the two departments to examine in detail the memorials submitted in response to the imperial call and report those that were urgent and essential.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials of the Secretariat and Chancellery to review memorials submitted in response to the call for counsel and report the most urgent items.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔百官輪對。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, an edict ordered the hundred officials to present themselves in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day an edict ordered officials to present themselves at court in rotation.

sentences.zh: 罷楊舜卿在京宮觀，林億年常州居住，陳源撫州居住。

translations.literal: Yang Shunqing was removed from the capital chapel; Lin Yinian was ordered to reside at Changzhou; Chen Yuan at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shunqing was removed from his capital chapel post; Lin Yinian was ordered to reside at Changzhou and Chen Yuan at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，命趙汝愚朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the ninth month, Zhao Ruyu was ordered to present offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the ninth month Zhao Ruyu was ordered to present offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命嗣秀王伯圭朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Heir Prince of Xiubo Gui was ordered to present offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Heir Prince of Xiu Bo Gui was ordered to offer sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是日，羅點薨。

translations.literal: That day, Luo Dian died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Luo Dian died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以刑部尚書京鏜簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Jing Yong, Minister of Justice, was appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Minister of Justice Jing Yong was appointed to sign at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，下詔撫諭諸將。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, an edict was issued to comfort and instruct the various commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day an edict was issued reassuring the frontier commanders.

sentences.zh: 改天祐節爲瑞慶節。

translations.literal: The Tianyou Festival was changed to the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianyou festival was renamed the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，右諫議大夫張叔椿再劾留正擅去相位，詔落正觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jichou day, Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Shuchun again impeached Liu Zheng for leaving the chancellorship on his own authority; an edict stripped Zheng of his title as Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the jichou day, Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Shuchun again impeached Liu Zheng for abandoning office; Liu was stripped of his title as academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，更泰安宮爲壽康宮。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Tai'an Palace was renamed Shoukang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Tai'an Palace was renamed Shoukang Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命四川制置司銓量諸州守臣。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Sichuan Pacification Commission was ordered to evaluate the prefectural administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the Sichuan pacification commission was ordered to review the qualifications of prefectural administrators.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雷。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔以陰陽謬盭，雷電非時，令台諫、侍從，各疏朝政闕失以聞。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, an edict stated that yin and yang were disordered and thunder and lightning came out of season; it ordered remonstrance officials and attendants each to memorialize on failures in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict cited disorder in yin and yang and untimely thunder and ordered remonstrance officials and attendants each to report lapses in governance.

sentences.zh: 戊戌。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day no further business was recorded.

sentences.zh: 復許武舉人試換文資。

translations.literal: Military examination candidates were again permitted to test for conversion to civil qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: Military examination graduates were again allowed to test for conversion to civil office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以久雨，命大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣決系囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, because of prolonged rain, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures and counties of the two Zhe circuits were ordered to decide cases of detained prisoners and release those below the rod punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, because of prolonged rain, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Palace Commands, Lin'an, and the Two Zhe circuits were ordered to review prisoners and release those sentenced to beating or less.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，減兩浙、江東西路和市折帛錢，蠲兩浙路丁鹽、身丁錢一年。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the market cloth-conversion money of the two Zhe and Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits was reduced, and the ding salt and head-tax money of the Zhe circuit was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day market cloth-conversion levies in Zhe and Jiangdong-Jiangxi were reduced, and the Zhe circuit's salt and head taxes were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 雅州蠻寇邊，土丁拒退之，尋出降。

translations.literal: Yi tribesmen of Yazhou raided the border; local militia repelled them, and shortly they came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Tribesmen of Ya Prefecture raided the border; local militia drove them back and they soon surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以朱熹言，趣後省看詳應詔封事。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, on Zhu Xi's advice, the rear secretariat was urged to examine in detail the memorials submitted in response to the imperial call.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, at Zhu Xi's urging, the rear secretariat was ordered to expedite review of memorials submitted in response to the call for counsel.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上大行至尊壽皇聖帝諡曰哲文神武成孝皇帝，廟號孝宗。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the late emperor, Supreme Sagely Emperor Shouhuang, was given the posthumous title Zhewen Shenwu Chengxiao and the temple name Xiaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the late emperor was given the posthumous title Zhewen Shenwu Chengxiao and the temple name Xiaozong.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復以朱熹奏請，卻瑞慶節賀表。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, again on Zhu Xi's memorial request, congratulatory documents for the Ruiqing Festival were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, again at Zhu Xi's request, congratulatory documents for the Ruiqing festival were declined.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，改上安穆皇后諡曰成穆皇后，安恭皇后諡曰成恭皇后。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, the posthumous title of Empress Anmu was changed to Empress Chengmu, and that of Empress Angong to Empress Chenggong.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Empress Anmu was posthumously renamed Empress Chengmu and Empress Angong Empress Chenggong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣曾三復使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Zeng Sanfu was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Zeng Sanfu was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上孝宗皇帝冊寶于重華殿，成穆皇后、成恭皇后冊寶于本室。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, the seal and treasure of Emperor Xiaozong were elevated at Chonghua Hall; those of Empress Chengmu and Empress Chenggong were elevated in their respective chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Xiaozong's seals and regalia were installed at Chonghua Hall, and those of Empresses Chengmu and Chenggong in their respective chambers.

sentences.zh: 是月，建福寧殿。

translations.literal: That month, Funing Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: That month Funing Hall was built.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，以吏部尚書鄭僑等奏請祧僖、宣二祖，正太祖東向之位，尋立僖祖別廟，以藏順、翼、宣三祖之主。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the intercalary month, on the memorial of Zheng Qiao, Minister of Personnel, and others requesting the removal of the tablets of ancestors Xi and Xuan, the position of Taizu facing east was corrected; shortly a separate temple for ancestor Xi was established to house the spirit tablets of ancestors Shun, Yi, and Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the intercalary month, at Minister of Personnel Zheng Qiao's memorial, ancestors Xi and Xuan were removed from the main line and Taizu's eastern-facing position was restored; a separate temple for Xi was then built to house the tablets of Shun, Yi, and Xuan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣林季友使金報謝。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Lin Jiyou was dispatched as envoy to Jin to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Lin Jiyou was sent to Jin to return thanks.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金遣使來弔祭。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Jin dispatched envoys to come and offer condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Jin sent envoys to offer mourning sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，侍講朱熹以上疏忤韓侂胄罷，趙汝愚力諫，不聽；

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Lecturer Zhu Xi was dismissed because his memorial offended Han Tuozhou; Zhao Ruyu remonstrated forcefully, but [the emperor] did not listen;
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Lecturer Zhu Xi was dismissed after a memorial offended Han Tuozhou; Zhao Ruyu protested strongly but was not heeded;

sentences.zh: 台諫、給舍交章請留朱熹，亦不聽。

translations.literal: censors, remonstrators, and drafting officials submitted memorials in succession requesting that Zhu Xi be retained, but again [the emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: censors, remonstrators, and drafting officials submitted successive memorials asking that Zhu Xi be kept on, but the emperor again refused.

sentences.zh: 詔兩省、台諫、侍從各舉宗室有文學器識者二人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered officials of the two departments, remonstrance censors, and attendants each to recommend two members of the imperial clan possessing literary learning and discernment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Secretariat, Chancellery, remonstrance officials, and attendants each to nominate two imperial clansmen noted for learning and judgment.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔改明年爲慶元元年。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day an edict declared the coming year the first year of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，復加安南國王李龍𣉙濟美功臣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, the title Jimei meritorious minister was again bestowed on the king of Annan, Li Long.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, the king of Annan, Li Long, was again granted the title of Jimei meritorious minister.

sentences.zh: 丙午，帝自重華宮還大內。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, the Emperor returned from Chonghua Palace to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the emperor returned from Chonghua Palace to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以宜州觀察使韓侂胄兼樞密都承旨。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Han Tuozhou, surveillance commissioner of Yizhou, was made concurrent Chief Coordinator of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Han Tuozhou, surveillance commissioner of Yi Prefecture, was named concurrent chief coordinator at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, trees rained ice.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day glaze ice formed on the trees.

sentences.zh: 詔行孝宗三年喪制，命禮官條具典禮以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the three-year mourning regulations for Xiaozong to be carried out and commanded ritual officials to set forth the canonical rites in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiaozong's three-year mourning observed and directed ritual officials to draft the full ceremonial code and report.

sentences.zh: 升明州爲慶元府。

translations.literal: Mingzhou was elevated to Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Prefecture was elevated to Qingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，權欑孝宗皇帝于永阜陵。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Emperor Xiaozong was provisionally interred at Yongfu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Emperor Xiaozong was provisionally interred at Yongfu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳朔，禁民間妄言宮禁事。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, the dingsi day, rumor about palace matters was forbidden among the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month private talk about palace affairs was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，吏部侍郎彭龜年上疏言韓侂胄假託聲勢，竊弄威福，乞黜之，以解天下之疑。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Guinian memorialized that Han Tuozhou borrowed others' prestige, usurped authority and bestowed favor, and begged that he be dismissed to dispel the realm's doubts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Vice Minister Peng Guinian memorialized that Han Tuozhou traded on borrowed prestige and abused power, and asked that he be removed to clear public suspicion.

sentences.zh: 詔罷龜年，進侂胄一官，與在京宮觀。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Guinian, advanced Tuozhou one grade in office, and granted him a capital palace chapel.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Peng Guinian, promoted Han Tuozhou one rank, and gave him a post at a capital palace chapel.

sentences.zh: 趙汝愚請留龜年，不聽。

translations.literal: Zhao Ruyu requested that Guinian be retained; [the emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ruyu asked that Peng Guinian be kept on, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞謝深甫劾陳傅良，罷之。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Xie Shenfu impeached Chen Fuliang and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Xie Shenfu impeached Chen Fuliang and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以陳康伯配饗孝宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Chen Kangbo was granted co-sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Chen Kangbo was granted co-sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple.

sentences.zh: 己巳，陳騤罷。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Chen Gui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Chen Gui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以餘端禮知樞密院事，京鏜參知政事，鄭僑同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Yu Duanli was made Commissioner of Military Affairs, Jing Yong Vice Grand Councilor, and Zheng Qiao Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Yu Duanli became military affairs commissioner, Jing Yong vice grand councilor, and Zheng Qiao associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，監察御史劉德秀劾起居舍人劉光祖，罷之。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Supervising Censor Liu Dexiu impeached Diarist Liu Guangzu and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Supervising Censor Liu Dexiu impeached Diarist Liu Guangzu and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金遣使來賀登位。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the accession.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Jin sent envoys to congratulate the accession.

sentences.zh: 上孝宗廟樂曰《大倫之舞》。

translations.literal: The music for Xiaozong's temple was elevated under the title Dance of the Great Human Relations.
translations.idiomatic: The temple music for Xiaozong was set as the Dance of the Great Human Relations.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祔孝宗神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Xiaozong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Xiaozong's spirit tablet was installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，減臨安、紹興二府死罪以下囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, prisoners below capital crime in Lin'an and Shaoxing were reduced in sentence, and those below the rod punishment were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day sentences were reduced for prisoners below capital crime in Lin'an and Shaoxing, and those sentenced to beating or less were released.

sentences.zh: 蠲民緣欑宮役者賦。

translations.literal: Taxes were remitted for the people conscripted for mausoleum labor.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes were remitted for commoners drafted for mausoleum labor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，加郭師禹少師，進封永寧郡王。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Guo Shiyu was advanced to Junior Preceptor and promoted in enfeoffment to Prince of Yongning commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Guo Shiyu was made junior preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 癸未，金遣使來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Jin dispatched envoys to congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Jin sent envoys to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙、淮南、江東西路水旱，振之，仍蠲其賦。

translations.literal: That year, the two Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits suffered flood and drought; relief was given, and their taxes were still remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods and drought struck Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong-Jiangxi; relief was distributed and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年春正月丁巳朔，蠲兩淮租稅。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Qingyuan, on the first day, the dingsi day, the land tax of the two Huai regions was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of the first year of Qingyuan land tax in the Two Huai regions was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，黎州蠻寇邊，官軍戰卻之。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Yi tribesmen of Lizhou raided the border; government troops fought and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day tribesmen of Li Prefecture raided the border and were driven back by government troops.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蠲台、嚴、湖三州貧民身丁、折帛錢一年。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the head-tax and cloth-conversion money of poor households in the three prefectures of Tai, Yan, and Hu were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day head tax and cloth-conversion levies for the poor in Tai, Yan, and Hu prefectures were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 詔兩浙、淮南、江東路荒歉諸州收養遺棄小兒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the famine-stricken prefectures of the two Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong circuits to take in abandoned infants.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered famine-hit prefectures in Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong to take in abandoned children.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以久雨，振給臨安貧民。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, because of prolonged rain, relief was distributed to the poor of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day prolonged rain prompted relief for the poor of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳朔，詔兩淮諸州勸民墾辟荒田。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, the dingsi day, an edict ordered the various prefectures of the two Huai regions to encourage the people to open wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month an edict urged the Two Huai prefectures to encourage reclamation of wasteland.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔嗣秀王伯圭贊拜不名。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, an edict granted Heir Prince of Xiu Bo Gui the privilege of bowing in support without having his name called.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Heir Prince of Xiu Bo Gui was granted the privilege of supportive bowing without having his name announced.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以久雨，釋大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, because of prolonged rain, prisoners below the rod punishment in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an Prefecture, and the two Zhe circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day prolonged rain led to release of prisoners sentenced to beating or less in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an, and the Two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔帥臣、監司歲終考察郡守臧否以聞。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, an edict ordered commanders and supervisory commissioners at year's end to examine prefects for merit and fault and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day commanders and supervisory commissioners were ordered to evaluate prefects at year's end and report.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以右正言李沐言，罷趙汝愚爲觀文殿大學士、知福州。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, on the statement of Right Rectifier Li Mu, Zhao Ruyu was dismissed and made Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, at Right Rectifier Li Mu's urging, Zhao Ruyu was removed and made academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，雨土。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 以餘端禮兼參知政事。

translations.literal: Yu Duanli was appointed concurrently as Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Duanli was named concurrent vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，兵部侍郎章穎以党趙汝愚罷。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, Vice Minister of War Zhang Ying was dismissed for factional association with Zhao Ruyu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Vice Minister Zhang Ying was dismissed for siding with Zhao Ruyu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，謝深甫等再劾汝愚，詔與宮觀。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Xie Shenfu and others again impeached Ruyu; an edict assigned him a palace chapel.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Xie Shenfu and others again impeached Zhao Ruyu, and he was given a palace chapel post.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, the bingxu day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Venus crossed the celestial meridian.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔四川歲發西兵詣行在，如舊制。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, an edict ordered that each year Sichuan dispatch western troops to the traveling court, as in the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Sichuan was ordered to send western troops annually to court under the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命侍從、台諫、兩省集議江南沿江諸州行鐵錢利害。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, attendants, remonstrance censors, and the two departments were ordered to assemble and deliberate on the advantages and disadvantages of circulating iron cash in the Yangtze-river prefectures of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day attendants, remonstrance officials, and the two departments were ordered to debate the merits of iron cash along the Jiangnan Yangtze coast.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，國子祭酒李祥、博士楊簡以党趙汝愚罷。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Libationer of the Directorate of Education Li Xiang and Erudite Yang Jian were dismissed for factional association with Zhao Ruyu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Libationer Li Xiang and Erudite Yang Jian were dismissed for siding with Zhao Ruyu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，太府寺丞呂祖儉坐上疏留趙汝愚及論不當黜朱熹、彭龜年等，忤韓侂胄，送韶州安置。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingsi day, Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Lü Zujian, because he memorialized to retain Zhao Ruyu and argued that Zhu Xi, Peng Guinian, and others should not have been dismissed, offended Han Tuozhou and was sent to Shaozhou for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the dingsi day, Treasury vice director Lü Zujian was sent to Shaozhou for resettlement after memorializing to keep Zhao Ruyu and protesting the dismissals of Zhu Xi and Peng Guinian, thereby offending Han Tuozhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，以餘端禮爲右丞相，京鏜知樞密院事，鄭僑參知政事，謝深甫簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Yu Duanli was made Right Chancellor, Jing Yong Commissioner of Military Affairs, Zheng Qiao Vice Grand Councilor, and Xie Shenfu appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Yu Duanli became right chancellor, Jing Yong military affairs commissioner, Zheng Qiao vice grand councilor, and Xie Shenfu was appointed to sign at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太學生楊宏中等六人以上書留趙汝愚、章穎、李祥、楊簡，請黜李沐，詔宏中等各送五百里外編管。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, six Imperial University students including Yang Hongzhong submitted a joint memorial to retain Zhao Ruyu, Zhang Ying, Li Xiang, and Yang Jian and request the dismissal of Li Mu; an edict ordered Hongzhong and the others each sent for supervised resettlement five hundred li beyond [the capital].
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day six Imperial University students led by Yang Hongzhong petitioned to restore Zhao Ruyu, Zhang Ying, Li Xiang, and Yang Jian and remove Li Mu; the court ordered each student exiled for supervised resettlement five hundred li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人鄧馹上疏救之，不聽。

translations.literal: Drafting Official Deng Chi memorialized to save them; [the emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Official Deng Chi memorialized in their defense, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，臨安大疫，出內帑錢爲貧民醫藥、棺斂費及賜諸軍疫死者家。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, a great epidemic struck Lin'an; funds from the inner treasury were disbursed for medicine and burial expenses of the poor and to bestow on the families of soldiers who died of the epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day a great epidemic struck Lin'an; inner treasury funds paid for medicine and burials for the poor and compensated families of soldiers who died of plague.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，呂祖儉改送吉州安置。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuzi day, Lü Zujian was transferred for resettlement to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuzi day, Lü Zujian was transferred to Jizhou for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔戒百官朋比。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, an edict warned the hundred officials against forming factions.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict warned officials against factional collusion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔諸路提舉司置廣惠倉，修胎養令。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict ordered the supervisory commissions of the various circuits to establish Broad Relief granaries and revise the regulations on fetal nurture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day circuits were ordered to establish Broad Relief granaries and revise regulations on care for pregnant women and infants.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，減大理、三衙、臨安府雜犯死罪以下囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, prisoners below capital crime for miscellaneous offenses in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, and Lin'an Prefecture were reduced in sentence, and those below the rod punishment were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day sentences were reduced for miscellaneous offenders below capital crime in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, and Lin'an, and those sentenced to beating or less were released.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，復留正觀文殿大學士，充醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the dingsi day, Liu Zheng was restored as Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and made commissioner of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingsi day, Liu Zheng was restored as academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and made commissioner of Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 右正言劉德秀請考核真偽，以辨邪正。

translations.literal: Right Rectifier Liu Dexiu requested examination of authenticity and falsity to distinguish the heterodox from the orthodox.
translations.idiomatic: Right Rectifier Liu Dexiu asked that doctrines be examined for authenticity to distinguish orthodoxy from heterodoxy.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣汪義端賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Wang Yiduan was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Wang Yiduan was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔三衙、江上諸軍主帥、將佐，初除舉自代一人，歲薦所知二人。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, an edict ordered the Three Commands, commanders of the various armies along the Yangtze, and their aides: upon first appointment each should recommend one person to succeed himself, and each year recommend two persons he knew.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day commanders of the Three Commands and Yangtze armies were ordered upon first appointment to nominate one successor and each year to recommend two men they knew.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以韓侂胄爲保寧軍節度使、提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Han Tuozhou was made military commissioner of the Baoning Army and supervisor of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Han Tuozhou was made military commissioner of the Baoning Army and supervisor of Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，加周必大少傅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renchen day, Zhou Bida was advanced to Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the renchen day, Zhou Bida was promoted to junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，落趙汝愚觀文殿大學士，罷宮觀。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Zhao Ruyu was stripped of his title as Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and dismissed from his palace chapel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Zhao Ruyu was stripped of his academician title and removed from his palace chapel post.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，詔內外諸軍主帥條奏武備邊防之策以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, an edict ordered commanders of all armies within and without to memorialize in detail on policies for armaments and frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, army commanders throughout the realm were ordered to submit detailed plans on armaments and frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，蠲臨安府水災貧民賦。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the renwu day, the taxes of poor households in Lin'an affected by flood were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month taxes were remitted for flood-stricken poor households in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以久雨，決系囚。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, because of prolonged rain, detained prisoners were decided upon.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day prolonged rain prompted review of detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，災惑入太微。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the disaster star Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣黃艾使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Huang Ai was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Huang Ai was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 己酉，蠲台、嚴、湖三州被災民丁絹。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, the ding silk of disaster-affected households in the three prefectures of Tai, Yan, and Hu was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day head-tax silk was remitted for disaster victims in Tai, Yan, and Hu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，詔三省、樞密院條上合教諸軍例。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jimao day, an edict ordered the three departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs to set forth in detail the regulations for instructing the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the jimao day, the three departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were ordered to draft regulations for army instruction.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，升秀州爲嘉興府，舒州爲安慶府，嘉州爲嘉定府，英州爲英德府。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Xiuzhou was elevated to Jiaxing Prefecture, Shuzhou to Anqing Prefecture, Jiazhou to Jiading Prefecture, and Yingzhou to Yingde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Xiu Prefecture became Jiaxing Prefecture, Shu became Anqing, Jia became Jiading, and Ying became Yingde.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金遣吳鼎樞來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Jin dispatched Wu Dingshu to come and congratulate the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Jin sent Wu Dingshu to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封子恭爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the son Gong was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the prince's son Gong was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，雨土。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jichou day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jichou day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以弟徐國公抦爲昭慶軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, the younger brother, Prince of Xu Bing, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the emperor's younger brother, Prince of Xu Bing, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoqing Army.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，加上壽聖隆慈備福太皇太后尊號曰壽聖隆慈備福光佑太皇太后，壽成皇太后曰壽成惠慈皇太后，太上皇曰聖安壽仁太上皇，太上皇后曰壽仁太上皇后。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, honorific titles were added: the Grand Empress Dowager Shousheng Longci Beifu was titled Grand Empress Dowager Shousheng Longci Beifu Guangyou; Empress Dowager Shoucheng was titled Empress Dowager Shoucheng Huici; the Retired Emperor was titled Retired Emperor Sheng'an Shouren; the Retired Empress was titled Retired Empress Shouren.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day extended honorific titles were granted to the grand empress dowager, empress dowager, retired emperor, and retired empress.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以監察御史胡紘言，責授趙汝愚寧遠軍節度副使、永州安置。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, on the statement of Supervising Censor Hu Hong, Zhao Ruyu was demoted and appointed deputy military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army for resettlement at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, at Supervising Censor Hu Hong's urging, Zhao Ruyu was demoted to deputy military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army and sent to Yongzhou for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命宰執大閱。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the chief ministers were ordered to conduct a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the chief ministers were ordered to conduct a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，置楚州弩手效用軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guihai day, the Chuzhou Crossbowmen Service Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guihai day, the Chuzhou Crossbowmen Service Army was established.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命朱熹爲煥章閣待制，辭。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Zhu Xi was appointed Attendant Gentleman at the Huanzhang Pavilion; he declined.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Zhu Xi was appointed attendant gentleman at the Huanzhang Pavilion but declined.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，金遣紇石烈正來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Jin dispatched Hesheli Zheng to come and congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Jin sent Hesheli Zheng to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚寅，以餘端禮爲左丞相，京鏜爲右丞相，鄭僑知樞密院事，謝深甫參知政事，御史中丞何澹同知樞密院事，庚子，趙汝愚卒於永州。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the gengyin day, Yu Duanli was made Left Chancellor, Jing Yong Right Chancellor, Zheng Qiao Commissioner of Military Affairs, Xie Shenfu Vice Grand Councilor, and Censor-in-Chief He Dan Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs; on the gengzi day, Zhao Ruyu died at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Yu Duanli became left chancellor, Jing Yong right chancellor, Zheng Qiao military affairs commissioner, Xie Shenfu vice grand councilor, and He Dan associate military affairs commissioner; on the gengzi day Zhao Ruyu died at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，右諫議大夫劉德秀劾留正引用偽學之黨，詔落正觀文殿大學士，罷宮觀。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Right Remonstrance Grandee Liu Dexiu impeached Liu Zheng for employing the faction of false learning; an edict stripped Zheng of his title as Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature and dismissed him from his palace chapel.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Right Remonstrance Grandee Liu Dexiu impeached Liu Zheng for patronizing the false-learning faction; Liu was stripped of his academician title and removed from his chapel post.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，詔追復趙汝愚官，許歸葬，以中書舍人吳宗旦言，罷之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinyou day, an edict posthumously restored Zhao Ruyu's offices and permitted his burial to return [to his home]; on the statement of Drafting Official Wu Zongdan, this was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinyou day, an edict posthumously restored Zhao Ruyu's rank and permitted his remains to be returned home for burial, but Drafting Official Wu Zongdan's protest led to revocation.

sentences.zh: 辛未，再蠲臨安府民身丁錢三年。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, the head-tax money of the people of Lin'an Prefecture was again remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Lin'an head tax was again remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，命諸軍射鐵簾。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingshen day, the various armies were ordered to shoot at the iron curtain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingshen day, all armies were ordered to practice shooting at the iron curtain target.

sentences.zh: 己亥，進封弟抦爲吳興郡王。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the younger brother Bing was advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Wuxing commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the younger brother Bing was promoted to Prince of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，有司上《慶元會計錄》。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, the relevant offices submitted the Qingyuan Accounting Records.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the relevant offices submitted the Qingyuan Accounting Records.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，餘端禮罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, Yu Duanli was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the jiazi day, Yu Duanli was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以何澹參知政事，吏部尚書葉翥簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, He Dan was made Vice Grand Councilor, and Ye Zhu, Minister of Personnel, was appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day He Dan became vice grand councilor and Minister of Personnel Ye Zhu was appointed to sign at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，增置監察御史一員。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, one additional Supervising Censor was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day one additional supervising censor was added.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以旱，禱於天地、宗廟、祖稷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, because of drought, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, drought prompted prayers at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.

sentences.zh: 詔大理、三衙、臨安府、兩浙州縣決系囚。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures and counties of the two Zhe circuits to decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an, and Two Zhe counties to review detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，申嚴獄囚瘐死之罰。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, penalties for prisoners dying of neglect in jail were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day penalties for deaths of prisoners from jail neglect were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜禮部進士鄒應龍以下四百九十有九人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, four hundred ninety-nine Metropolitan Examination graduates including Zou Yinglong were granted passage and qualification.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day four hundred ninety-nine metropolitan graduates led by Zou Yinglong received degrees and qualification.

sentences.zh: 甲午，減諸路和市折帛錢三年。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, the market cloth-conversion money of the various circuits was reduced for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day market cloth-conversion levies throughout the circuits were reduced for three years.

sentences.zh: 建華文閣，以藏孝宗御集。

translations.literal: The Huawen Pavilion was built to house Xiaozong's collected writings.
translations.idiomatic: Huawen Pavilion was built to house Xiaozong's collected writings.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，更慈福宮爲壽慈宮。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Cifu Palace was renamed Shouci Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Cifu Palace was renamed Shouci Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，遣吳宗旦賀金主生辰，乙丑，命監司、帥守臧否縣令，分三等，丙子，子埈生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengxu day, Wu Zongdan was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday; on the yichou day, supervisory commissioners and commanders were ordered to judge prefectural magistrates as good or bad in three grades; on the bingzi day, the son Jun was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wu Zongdan was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday; on the yichou day supervisory commissioners and commanders were ordered to grade county magistrates in three tiers; on the bingzi day the prince's son Jun was born.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，饗於太廟。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the guiwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，減諸路死罪囚，釋流以下。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, capital convicts in the various circuits were reduced in sentence, and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day sentences were reduced for capital convicts throughout the circuits, and those below exile were released.

sentences.zh: 戊子，量徙流人呂祖儉等於內郡。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, exiles including Lü Zujian were measured for transfer to inner prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day exiles including Lü Zujian were transferred to inner prefectures as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 詔檢正、都司考核諸路守臣便民五事以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the rectification and metropolitan offices to examine the five matters by which circuit administrators benefited the people and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the rectification and metropolitan offices to evaluate how circuit administrators served the people in five areas and report.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以韓侂胄爲開府儀同三司、萬壽觀使。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Han Tuozhou was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and commissioner of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Han Tuozhou was granted Kaifu Yitong Sansi and made commissioner of Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，奉安孝宗皇帝、成穆皇后、成恭皇后神御于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the guichou day, the spirit images of Emperor Xiaozong, Empress Chengmu, and Empress Chenggong were installed at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guichou day, the spirit images of Xiaozong and Empresses Chengmu and Chenggong were installed at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，乙太常少卿胡紘請，權住進擬偽學之黨。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, on the request of Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Hu Hong, advancement nominations for the faction of false learning were provisionally halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, at Vice Director Hu Hong's request, nominations advancing members of the false-learning faction were suspended.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，子埈薨，追封兗王，諡沖惠。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the son Jun died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and given the posthumous title Chonghui.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the prince's son Jun died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yan with the posthumous title Chonghui.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，復分利州爲東西、路。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the dinghai day, Lizhou was again divided into eastern and western circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dinghai day, Li Prefecture was again divided into eastern and western circuits.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，嗣濮王士歆薨，追封韶王。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Heir Prince of Pu Shixin died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Heir Prince of Pu Shixin died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shao.

sentences.zh: 甲午，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day a meteor fell in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣張貴謨使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Zhang Guimo was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Zhang Guimo was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，率群臣奉上壽聖隆慈備福光佑太皇太后、壽成惠慈皇太后、聖安壽仁太上皇、壽仁太上皇后冊寶於慈福、壽康宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the wushen day, [the emperor] led the hundred officials in presenting the seals and treasures to the Grand Empress Dowager Shousheng Longci Beifu Guangyou, Empress Dowager Shoucheng Huici, Retired Emperor Sheng'an Shouren, and Retired Empress Shouren at Cifu and Shoukang Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the wushen day, the emperor led the officials in presenting seals and regalia to the grand empress dowager, empress dowager, retired emperor, and retired empress at Cifu and Shoukang Palaces.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，冊皇后。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the empress was enshrined.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the empress received her investiture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，金遣張嗣來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Jin dispatched Zhang Si to come and congratulate the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Jin sent Zhang Si to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大閱。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，詣壽康宮，上《太上皇帝寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengyin day, [the emperor] went to Shoukang Palace and presented the Retired Emperor's Clemency Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengyin day, he went to Shoukang Palace and presented the Retired Emperor's Clemency Edicts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，京鏜等上《孝宗皇帝寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Jing Yong and others presented the Emperor Xiaozong Clemency Edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Jing Yong and others presented Xiaozong's Clemency Edicts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賞宜州捕降峒寇功。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, rewards were given for the merit of capturing and accepting the surrender of cave bandits in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day rewards were given for capturing and accepting the surrender of cave bandits in Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，金遣完顏崇道來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinwei day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Chongdao to come and congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinwei day, Jin sent Wanyan Chongdao to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是月，監察御史沈繼祖劾朱熹，詔落熹秘閣修撰，罷宮觀。

translations.literal: That month, Supervising Censor Shen Jizu impeached Zhu Xi; an edict stripped Xi of his post as Hanlin Compiler and dismissed him from his palace chapel.
translations.idiomatic: That month Supervising Censor Shen Jizu impeached Zhu Xi; Xi was stripped of his Hanlin compiler post and removed from his chapel appointment.

sentences.zh: 竄處士蔡元定於道州。

translations.literal: The scholar-recluse Cai Yuanding was banished to Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The scholar Cai Yuanding was banished to Dao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬寅，鄭僑罷。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the renyin day, Zheng Qiao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on the renyin day, Zheng Qiao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以謝深甫兼知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Xie Shenfu was made concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Xie Shenfu was named concurrent military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，京鏜等上《神宗玉牒》、《高宗實錄》。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiyou day, Jing Yong and others presented the Shenzong Genealogy and the Gaozong Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiyou day, Jing Yong and others presented the Shenzong Genealogy and Gaozong Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以大理司直邵褎然請詔大臣自今權臣、偽學之黨，勿除在內差遣。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, on the request of Direct Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review Shao Youran, an edict ordered that from now on powerful ministers and the faction of false learning should not be appointed to inner-court assignments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, at Direct Clerk Shao Youran's request, an edict barred powerful ministers and the false-learning faction from inner-court appointments.

sentences.zh: 詔下其章。

translations.literal: An edict promulgated his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The court promulgated his memorial as edict.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，建東華門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yiwei day, the Donghua Gate was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yiwei day, Donghua Gate was built.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禁浙西州軍圍田。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, encircling fields was forbidden in the prefectures and armies of western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day encircling farmland was forbidden in western Zhe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔自今有司奏讞死罪不當者，論如律。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, an edict ordered that from now on when offices memorialized that capital sentences were improper, they should be punished according to the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict required that officials who approved improper capital sentences be punished under the law.

sentences.zh: 」夏四月丙午，雨土。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingwu day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the bingwu day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 命不𥞋爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Bu Lin was ordered to be Heir Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Lin was named Heir Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以旱禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, because of drought, prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day drought prompted prayers at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the state altars.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，頒《淳熙寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, the Chunxi Clemency Edicts were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, the Chunxi Clemency Edicts were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，內出銅器付尚書省毀之，命申嚴私鑄銅器之禁。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the intercalary month, bronze vessels from the inner palace were turned over to the Ministry of Works for destruction, and the prohibition on private casting of bronze vessels was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the intercalary month bronze vessels from the inner palace were sent to the Ministry of Works for destruction and private bronze casting was strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣衛涇賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Wei Jing was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Wei Jing was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔留正分司西京、邵州居住。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, an edict ordered Liu Zheng to serve in a nominal post at the Western Capital and reside at Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Liu Zheng was ordered to hold a nominal post at the Western Capital and reside at Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是夏，廣東提舉茶鹽徐安國遣人捕私鹽于大奚山，島民遂作亂。

translations.literal: That summer, Xu Anguo, Guangdong Commissioner for Tea and Salt, sent men to seize illicit salt on Great Xi Mountain; the islanders thereupon rose in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Guangdong tea-and-salt commissioner Xu Anguo sent men to seize illicit salt on Great Xi Mountain, and the islanders rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，監察御史沈繼祖錄淹囚四百餘條來上，詔進二官。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Supervising Censor Shen Jizu recorded more than four hundred cases of long-detained prisoners and submitted them; an edict advanced him two grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the gengwu day, Supervising Censor Shen Jizu submitted records of more than four hundred long-detained prisoners and was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，復置嚴州神泉監。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day, the Shenquan Directorate of Yanzhou was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day, the Shenquan mint of Yan Prefecture was re-established.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，知廣州錢之望遣兵入大奚山，盡殺島民。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Qian Zhiwang, prefect of Guangzhou, dispatched troops into Great Xi Mountain and killed all the islanders.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Guangzhou prefect Qian Zhiwang sent troops into Great Xi Mountain and massacred the islanders.

sentences.zh: 甲午，均諸路職田。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, official fields in the various circuits were equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day official salary fields throughout the circuits were equalized.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，以四川旱，詔蠲民賦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, because of drought in Sichuan, an edict remitted the people's taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, Sichuan drought prompted remission of popular taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣曾炎使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Zeng Yan was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Zeng Yan was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申嚴帥臣、監司臧否郡守之制。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the regulations for commanders and supervisory commissioners to judge prefects as good or bad were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day rules requiring commanders and commissioners to evaluate prefects were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔監司、帥守薦舉改官，勿用偽學之人。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered that when supervisory commissioners and commanders recommended candidates for office change, persons of false learning should not be used.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict barred commissioners and commanders from recommending false-learning adherents for promotion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，雷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the guiyou day, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the guiyou day, thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，金遣完顏愈來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Jin dispatched Wanyan Yu to come and congratulate the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Jin sent Wanyan Yu to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 丙申，乙太皇太后違豫，赦。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; an amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the grand empress dowager fell ill and an amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，加孝宗皇帝諡曰紹統同道冠德昭功哲文神武明聖成孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the xinchou day, Emperor Xiaozong's posthumous title was augmented to Shaotong Tongdao Guande Zhaogong Zhewen Shenwu Mingsheng Chengxiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinchou day, Xiaozong's posthumous title was extended to Shaotong Tongdao Guande Zhaogong Zhewen Shenwu Mingsheng Chengxiao.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后吳氏崩。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager, née Wu, died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Empress Dowager Wu died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Mound, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Mound and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔爲大行太皇太后服期。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, an edict ordered mourning for the late Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day an edict ordered mourning for the late grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣趙介使金告哀。
