translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Zhao Jie was dispatched as envoy to Jin to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Zhao Jie was sent to Jin to announce the mourning.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，始御正殿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, [the emperor] first presided in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, the emperor first held court in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以大行太皇太后欑宮，蠲紹興府貧民明年身丁、折帛綿絹。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, because of the provisional interment of the late Grand Empress Dowager, the head-tax and cloth silk of poor households in Shaoxing Prefecture for the coming year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, for the grand empress dowager's provisional interment, Shaoxing's poor were exempted from next year's head tax and cloth levies.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷文武官納官告綾紙錢。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the payment of silk-paper money for appointment documents by civil and military officials was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day officials were no longer required to pay silk-paper fees for appointment documents.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雷，雨土。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, thunder; earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day there was thunder and dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙未，金遣奧屯忠孝來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Jin dispatched Aotun Zhongxiao to come and congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Jin sent Aotun Zhongxiao to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以知綿州王沇請，詔省部籍偽學姓名。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, on the request of Wang Yan, prefect of Mianzhou, an edict ordered the ministries to register the names of the false-learning faction.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, at Mian Prefecture prefect Wang Yan's request, the ministries were ordered to register names of the false-learning faction.

sentences.zh: 四年正月己卯，上欽宗皇后諡曰仁懷皇后。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the jimao day, Empress Renhuai of Emperor Qinzong was given her posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on the jimao day, Qinzong's empress was posthumously titled Empress Renhuai.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以葉翥同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Ye Zhu was made Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Ye Zhu was named associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔有司寬恤兩浙、江淮、荊湖、四川流民。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to show clemency to displaced persons in the two Zhe, Jianghuai, Jinghu, and Sichuan regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day offices were ordered to extend relief to displaced persons in Zhe, Jianghuai, Jinghu, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，詔兩省、侍從、台諫各舉所知一二人，毋薦宰執親黨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinwei day, an edict ordered the two departments, attendants, and remonstrance censors each to recommend one or two persons they knew, and not to recommend the close associates of chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinwei day, the two departments, attendants, and remonstrance officials were each ordered to recommend one or two men they knew, but not chancellors' kin or clients.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上大行太皇太后諡曰憲聖慈烈皇后。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, the late Grand Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Xiansheng Cilie.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the late grand empress dowager was posthumously titled Xiansheng Cilie.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，權欑憲聖慈烈皇后于永思陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jiazi day, Empress Xiansheng Cilie was provisionally interred at Yongsai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiazi day, the grand empress dowager was provisionally interred at Yongsai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，金遣烏林答天益來弔祭。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Jin dispatched Wulinada Tianyi to come and offer condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Jin sent Wulinada Tianyi to offer mourning sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，祔仁懷皇后、憲聖慈烈皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu day, the spirit tablets of Empress Renhuai and Empress Xiansheng Cilie were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the bingxu day, the spirit tablets of Empresses Renhuai and Xiansheng Cilie were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己丑，蠲臨安、紹興二府租稅有差。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the land tax of Lin'an and Shaoxing was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day land tax in Lin'an and Shaoxing was remitted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙申，始御正殿。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, [the emperor] first presided in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the emperor again held court in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，右諫議大夫張釜請下詔禁偽學。

translations.literal: That month, Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Fu requested that an edict be issued prohibiting false learning.
translations.idiomatic: That month Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhang Fu asked that an edict ban false learning.

sentences.zh: 遣湯碩使金報謝。

translations.literal: Tang Shuo was dispatched as envoy to Jin to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shuo was sent to Jin to return thanks.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，加韓侂胄少傅，賜玉帶。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jihai day, Han Tuozhou was advanced to Junior Tutor and granted a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jihai day, Han Tuozhou was made junior tutor and granted a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔禁偽學。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, an edict prohibited false learning.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict formally banned false learning.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，遣楊王休賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, Yang Wangxiu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, Yang Wangxiu was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以弟吳興郡王抦爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the younger brother, Prince of Wuxing Bing, was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the younger brother, Prince of Wuxing Bing, was granted Kaifu Yitong Sansi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，葉翥罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinyou day, Ye Zhu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the xinyou day, Ye Zhu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯朔，以久雨，決系囚。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, the dingmao day, because of prolonged rain, detained prisoners were decided upon.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month prolonged rain prompted review of detained prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以謝深甫知樞密院事兼參知政事，吏部尚書許及之同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Xie Shenfu was made Commissioner of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councilor, and Xu Jizhi, Minister of Personnel, was made Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Xie Shenfu became military affairs commissioner and concurrent vice grand councilor, and Minister Xu Jizhi associate military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day a white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔以太上皇聖躬清復，率群臣上壽。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, an edict stated that the Retired Emperor's sacred person had recovered clarity; [the emperor] led the hundred officials in offering longevity wishes.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict announced the retired emperor's recovery and ordered the emperor to lead officials in offering birthday felicitations.

sentences.zh: 尋不克行。

translations.literal: Shortly this could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was soon abandoned.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Venus crossed the celestial meridian.

sentences.zh: 丁未，頒《慶元重修敕令格式》。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, the Qingyuan Revised Statutes, Commands, and Formats were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the Qingyuan Revised Statutes, Commands, and Formats were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣馬覺使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Ma Jue was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Ma Jue was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔造新曆。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered the making of a new calendar.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered a new calendar compiled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，金遣孫鐸來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuzi day, Jin dispatched Sun Duo to come and congratulate the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the wuzi day, Jin sent Sun Duo to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，再蠲臨安府民身丁錢三年。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, the head-tax money of the people of Lin'an Prefecture was again remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, Lin'an head tax was again remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 己丑，金遣楊庭筠來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Jin dispatched Yang Tingyun to come and congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Jin sent Yang Tingyun to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚子，樞密院直省官蔡璉訴趙汝愚定策時有異謀，詔下大理捕鞫彭龜年、曾三聘等，以實其事。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the gengzi day, the Bureau of Military Affairs direct clerk Cai Lian accused Zhao Ruyu of having had a divergent plot at the time of settling the succession; an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review to arrest and interrogate Peng Guinian, Zeng Sanpin, and others to verify the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, on the gengzi day, military affairs clerk Cai Lian accused Zhao Ruyu of plotting at the succession crisis; the Court of Judicial Review was ordered to arrest Peng Guinian, Zeng Sanpin, and others to verify the charge.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人范仲藝力爭之于韓侂胄，事遂寢。

translations.literal: Drafting Official Fan Zhongyi argued forcefully against it to Han Tuozhou, and the matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Official Fan Zhongyi protested strongly to Han Tuozhou, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 張釜等復請窮治，詔停龜年、三聘官。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu and others again requested thorough prosecution; an edict suspended the offices of Guinian and Sanpin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu and others again demanded prosecution; Peng Guinian and Zeng Sanpin were suspended from office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，建玉堂。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Yutang Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Yutang Hall was built.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the guiyou day, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiyou day, a white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，張釜劾劉光祖附和偽學，詔房州居住。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Zhang Fu impeached Liu Guangzu for adhering to false learning; an edict ordered him to reside at Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Zhang Fu impeached Liu Guangzu for adhering to false learning and ordered him to reside at Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，罷監司臧否郡守之制。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jiawu day, the regulations for supervisory commissioners to judge prefects as good or bad were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiawu day, the system for commissioners to evaluate prefects was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬辰朔，新曆成，賜名曰《統天》。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month of summer, the renchen day, the new calendar was completed and given the name Unifying Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month the new calendar was completed and named Unifying Heaven.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賜禮部進士曾從龍以下四百十有一人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, four hundred eleven Metropolitan Examination graduates including Zeng Conglong were granted passage and qualification.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day four hundred eleven metropolitan graduates led by Zeng Conglong received degrees and qualification.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以久雨，民多疫，命臨安府振恤之。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, because of prolonged rain many people fell ill with epidemic disease; Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day prolonged rain brought widespread plague; Lin'an was ordered to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔諸路州學置武士齋，選官按其武藝。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, an edict ordered prefectural schools in the various circuits to establish military-student quarters and select officials to test their martial skills.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day circuits were ordered to establish military-student quarters in prefectural schools and appoint officials to test martial skills.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，遣李大性賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the guihai day, Li Daxing was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai day, Li Daxing was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，禁高麗、日本商人博易銅錢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiayin day, Korean and Japanese merchants were forbidden to trade in copper cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the jiayin day, Korean and Japanese merchants were forbidden to trade in copper cash.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the yihai day, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yihai day, a white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太祖廟楹生芝，率群臣詣壽康宮上壽，始見太上皇，成禮而還。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, lingzhi fungus grew on a pillar of Taizu's temple; [the emperor] led the hundred officials to Shoukang Palace to offer longevity wishes, first saw the Retired Emperor, completed the rites, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day lingzhi grew on a pillar of Taizu's temple; the emperor led officials to Shoukang Palace to offer birthday felicitations, met the retired emperor for the first time, completed the rites, and returned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以過宮上壽禮成，中外奉表稱賀。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, because the palace visit and longevity rites were completed, within and without memorials of congratulation were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, with the palace visit and birthday rites complete, court and country submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔減諸路流囚，釋杖以下，推恩如慶壽故事。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, an edict ordered reduction of exiled prisoners in the various circuits and release of those below the rod punishment, extending grace as in the precedent of celebrating longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day exiled prisoners throughout the circuits were reduced in sentence and those below beating released, extending grace as in the longevity-celebration precedent.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，進京鏜等官一級。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Jing Yong and others were advanced one grade in office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Jing Yong and others were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，立沿邊諸州武舉取士法。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, regulations were established for selecting men by military examination in the frontier prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day regulations were established for military-examination recruitment in frontier prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅朔，加韓侂胄少師，封平原郡王。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the gengyin day, Han Tuozhou was advanced to Junior Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month Han Tuozhou was made junior preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣朱致知使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Zhu Zhizhi was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Zhu Zhizhi was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申朔，封郭師禹爲廣陵郡王。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, the gengshen day, Guo Shiyu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month Guo Shiyu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣僕散琦來賀瑞慶節。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Jin dispatched Pusan Qi to come and congratulate the Ruiqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Jin sent Pusan Qi to congratulate the Ruiqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，詔復右司一員。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, the jichou day, an edict restored one post in the Right Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month one post in the Right Office was restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，嗣濮王不𥞋薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou day, Heir Prince of Pu Bu Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou day, Heir Prince of Pu Bu Lin died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命廣東水土惡弱諸州建安仁宅、惠濟倉庫，給士大夫死不能歸者。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, the prefectures of Guangdong with harsh soil and water were ordered to build Secure Benevolence lodges and Beneficent Relief granaries for scholar-officials who died and could not be returned home.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day harsh Guangdong prefectures were ordered to build lodges and relief granaries for scholar-officials who died far from home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，奉安仁懷皇后、憲聖慈烈皇后神御于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the spirit images of Empress Renhuai and Empress Xiansheng Cilie were installed at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the spirit images of Empresses Renhuai and Xiansheng Cilie were installed at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，金遣范楫來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Jin dispatched Fan Ji to come and congratulate the New Year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Jin sent Fan Ji to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，饒、信、江撫、嚴、衢、台七州、建昌、興國軍、廣東諸州皆水，振之。

translations.literal: That year, the seven prefectures of Rao, Xin, Jiangfu, Yan, Qu, and Tai, the Jianchang and Xingguo Armies, and the various prefectures of Guangdong all suffered flood; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods struck Rao, Xin, Jiangfu, Yan, Qu, Tai, Jianchang, Xingguo, and Guangdong; relief was distributed.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己亥，子坦生。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the jihai day, the son Tan was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, on the jihai day, the prince's son Tan was born.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，減諸路雜犯死罪囚，釋徒以下。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the wuchen day, prisoners below capital crime for miscellaneous offenses in the various circuits were reduced in sentence, and those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuchen day, miscellaneous offenders below capital crime were given reduced sentences throughout the circuits, and those below penal servitude were released.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雨土。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 己卯，率群臣奉上《聖安壽仁太上皇玉牒》、《聖政》、《日曆》、《會要》于壽康宮。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, [the emperor] led the hundred officials in presenting the Retired Emperor Sheng'an Shouren's Genealogy, Sagely Governance, Daily Calendar, and Essential Compilations at Shoukang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the emperor led officials in presenting the retired emperor's genealogy, Sagely Governance, Daily Calendar, and Essential Compilations at Shoukang Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封婕妤楊氏爲貴妃。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Lady of Handsome Fairness Yang was enfeoffed as Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Lady Yang was promoted to noble consort.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚寅，以京鏜爲左丞相，謝深甫爲右丞相，何澹知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the intercalary month, Jing Yong was made Left Chancellor, Xie Shenfu Right Chancellor, and He Dan Commissioner of Military Affairs and concurrent Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the intercalary month Jing Yong became left chancellor, Xie Shenfu right chancellor, and He Dan military affairs commissioner and concurrent vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復留正少保、觀文殿大學士致仕。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Liu Zheng was restored as Junior Guardian and Academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Liu Zheng was restored as junior guardian and retired academician of the Hall for Exalted Literature.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雨土。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以殿前副都指揮使吳曦爲昭信軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Wu Xi, Deputy Commander of the Palace Command, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Deputy Palace Commander Wu Xi was made military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，朱熹卒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jiazi day, Zhu Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiazi day, Zhu Xi died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，從壽成惠慈皇太后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, [the emperor] accompanied Empress Dowager Shoucheng Huici on a visit to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the emperor accompanied Empress Dowager Shoucheng on a visit to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 己卯，安定郡王子恭薨。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the son Gong of the Prince of Anding died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Prince of Anding's son Gong died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，命不璺爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiyou day, Bu Lin was ordered to be Heir Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the jiyou day, Bu Lin was named Heir Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，以旱，決中外系囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen day, because of drought, detained prisoners within and without were decided upon.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingchen day, drought prompted review of detained prisoners at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 除茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: The tea-and-salt reward money was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tea-and-salt reward levies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 有司上《慶元寬恤詔令》、《役法撮要》。

translations.literal: The relevant offices submitted the Qingyuan Clemency Edicts and the Abridged Corvée Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices submitted the Qingyuan Clemency Edicts and the Abridged Corvée Regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, [the emperor] avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced court meals.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔大理、三衙、臨安府及諸路闕雨州縣釋杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures and counties of the various circuits lacking rain to release prisoners below the rod punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day drought-hit counties were ordered to release prisoners sentenced to beating or less in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Commands, Lin'an, and the circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔侍從、台諫、兩省、卿監、郎官、館職疏陳闕失及當今急務。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, an edict ordered attendants, remonstrance censors, the two departments, ministers and supervisors, bureau officials, and academy appointees to memorialize in detail on failures and urgent matters of the present.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day attendants, remonstrance officials, the two departments, ministers, bureau officials, and academy appointees were ordered to report lapses and urgent current affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以久不雨，詔中外陳朝廷過失及時政利害。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, because rain had long been lacking, an edict ordered that within and without the failures of the court and the advantages and disadvantages of current policy be stated.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day prolonged drought prompted an edict calling for reports on court failures and current policy from throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雨。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔三省、樞密院擇臣僚封事可行者以聞。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict ordered the three departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs to select from officials' sealed memorials those that could be implemented and report them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day the three departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were ordered to select feasible items from officials' sealed memorials and report them.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, the yiyou day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以太上皇后違豫，赦。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, because the Retired Empress fell ill, an amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the retired empress fell ill and an amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太上皇后李氏崩。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, the Retired Empress, née Li, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Retired Empress Li died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣趙善義賀金主生辰，吳旴使金告哀。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, Zhao Shanyi was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday, and Wu Yu was sent as envoy to Jin to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Zhao Shanyi was sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday and Wu Yu to announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 戊申，許及之以母憂去位。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Xu Jizhi left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Xu Jizhi left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，初御後殿。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiwei day, [the emperor] first presided in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the jiwei day, the emperor first held court in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以御史中丞陳自強簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Chen Ziqiang, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Censor-in-chief Chen Ziqiang was appointed to sign at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，以太上皇違豫，赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, because the Retired Emperor fell ill, an amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengyin day, the retired emperor fell ill and an amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太上皇崩。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Retired Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the retired emperor died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣李寅仲使金告哀。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Li Yinzhong was dispatched as envoy to Jin to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Li Yinzhong was sent to Jin to announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 乙未，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上大行太上皇后諡曰慈懿皇后。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the late Retired Empress was given the posthumous title Ciyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the late retired empress was posthumously titled Empress Ciyi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day no further business was recorded.

sentences.zh: 京鏜薨。

translations.literal: Jing Yong died.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yong died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，子坦薨，追封邠王，諡沖溫。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the son Tan died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Bin and given the posthumous title Chongwen.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the prince's son Tan died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Bin with the posthumous title Chongwen.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，權攢慈懿皇后于臨安府南山之修吉寺。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Empress Ciyi was provisionally interred at Xiuji Temple on the southern hill of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Empress Ciyi was provisionally interred at Xiuji Temple on Lin'an's southern hill.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，祔慈懿皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yimao day, the spirit tablet of Empress Ciyi was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yimao day, Empress Ciyi's spirit tablet was installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲子，婺州布衣呂祖泰上書，請誅韓侂胄、蘇師旦，逐陳自強等，以周必大代之。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the commoner of Wuzhou Lü Zutai submitted a memorial requesting the execution of Han Tuozhou and Su Shidan, the expulsion of Chen Ziqiang and others, and that Zhou Bida replace them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Wuzhou commoner Lü Zutai memorialized asking that Han Tuozhou and Su Shidan be executed, Chen Ziqiang and others expelled, and Zhou Bida put in their place.

sentences.zh: 詔杖祖泰，配欽州牢城。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zutai beaten with the rod and banished to the Qinzhou prison fortress.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zutai beaten and banished to the Qinzhou prison fortress.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命謝深甫朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Xie Shenfu was ordered to present offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Xie Shenfu was ordered to present offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命嗣濮王不璺朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Heir Prince of Pu Bu Lin was ordered to present offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Heir Prince of Pu Bu Lin was ordered to offer sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，合祭天地於明堂。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣丁常任爲金國遺留國信使。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Ding Changren was dispatched as the Song remnant-state credentialed envoy to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Ding Changren was sent as the Song credentialed envoy remaining at Jin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，加韓侂胄太傅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingxu day, Han Tuozhou was advanced to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the bingxu day, Han Tuozhou was made grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣林桷使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Lin Jue was dispatched as envoy to Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Lin Jue was sent to Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復加安南國王李龍𣉙保節功臣。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the title Baojie meritorious minister was again bestowed on the king of Annan, Li Long.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the king of Annan, Li Long, was again granted the title of Baojie meritorious minister.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，雨土。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑朔，詔宗子與愿更名曮，爲福州觀察使。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, the guichou day, an edict ordered the imperial clansman Yuyuan to change his name to Yan and made him surveillance commissioner of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month clansman Yuyuan was renamed Yan and made surveillance commissioner of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，皇后韓氏崩。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, Empress Han died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Empress Han died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，子增生。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the son Zeng was born.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the prince's son Zeng was born.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，東北地震。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, the northeast quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day an earthquake struck the northeast.

sentences.zh: 上大行太上皇謚曰憲仁聖哲慈孝皇帝，廟號光宗。

translations.literal: The late Retired Emperor was given the posthumous title Xianren Shengzhe Cixiao and the temple name Guangzong.
translations.idiomatic: The late retired emperor was posthumously titled Xianren Shengzhe Cixiao with the temple name Guangzong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上大行皇后謚曰恭淑皇后。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the late empress was given the posthumous title Empress Gongshu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the late empress was posthumously titled Empress Gongshu.
